studies.title: Immunoreactivity of GPNMB (glycoprotein nonmetastatic melanoma protein B) across the spectrum of uterine mesenchymal tumours.

whitelisted_methods_only.label: MATERIALS AND METHODS
whitelisted_methods_only.text: We analysed a cohort of 115 uterine mesenchymal tumours, which included nine PEComas and a broad panel of differential diagnoses, comprising leiomyosarcoma (LMS, n = 19), STUMP (n = 20), leiomyoma (n = 10), low-grade endometrial stromal sarcoma (LG ESS, n = 18), high-grade ESS (HG ESS, n = 13), adenosarcoma (n = 11), undifferentiated uterine sarcoma (UUS, n = 5), inflammatory myofibroblastic tumour (IMT, n = 3) and a collection of rare entities (1 UTROSCT, 3 KAT6B/A::KANSL1-, 2 PLAG1- and 1 NTRK-rearranged sarcomas). Immunohistochemistry (IHC) for GPNMB was performed, and a case was strictly defined as positive only if it showed diffuse staining (>75% of tumour volume) of moderate to strong intensity.

studies.title: TFE3-rearranged ossifying fibromyxoid tumors are uniquely negative for glycoprotein non-metastatic melanoma protein B: A study of 13 TFE3-rearranged mesenchymal tumors.

whitelisted_methods_only.label: METHODS
whitelisted_methods_only.text: Our archive was interrogated for TFE3-rearranged non-renal neoplasms previously assessed with our RNA NGS panel. For each case, a whole-slide section was immunostained for GPNMB, and quantified using H-scores. The methylation profiles of the included tumor types were retrieved from our database.
